Read only source /evidence/source.json, parent /evidence/parent.json, and independent audit /evidence/audit.json. Do not use the web, any prior-run file other than those exact sealed inputs, any other solution, or any verification report. You may create exact-arithmetic checks only under /work; do not modify files outside /work.

Parent SHA-256: f0096362c2ac94a88f0ebac5dfdf7d651384b3f6c996b55f6ac99a367ffd81b1
Audit SHA-256: 8dfb8c5bfbcacc9ffc6497341b37143f3278ffbb38dfa2123a61d2f36cf0bae2

This is an exact-closure attempt after the three scheduled search lenses. Concentrate on resolving the independent audit. If no material proof change is required, copy claimed_resolution, every claim and proof_sketch, and final_writeup from the parent exactly.

Address every REFUTED or UNRESOLVED claim and the audit's target-coverage judgment. Preserve correct progress. Repair, narrow, replace, or remove unsupported claims. Never call the open target solved without a complete proof at the requested strength. Put every load-bearing claim in a separate results item in proof order. There is no claim-count cap. The entire ordered proof is in scope. Keep final_writeup under 3,000 words and each proof_sketch under 500 words.

This is O(mn+(m-n+1)(d+1)^2+(d+1)^3), hence O(mnq) in the worst case and O(mn) for constant d.",

Thus the infeasible lengths are exactly the selected set T, so complements realize every feasibility vector. Dimensions are common for fixed q and all entries have O(log q) bits.",

      "checker_path": "none"

      "claim": "The feasibility-oracle obstruction persists under randomization: bounded-error randomized algorithms require Omega(q) queries in the worst case.",

If that output is positive, success is at most (t+1)/(2q), no larger. Thus t<q/3 gives success below 2/3.       "verdict": "VERIFIED",

Hence F_l is 0 for even l and 1 for odd l. In the stated 2-by-3 matrix, the side-2 sums are 1 and 4, while F_1=2. With k=1 no positive side is feasible, but shrinking at the second side-2 placement without revisiting the earlier value 2 can return 1.",

      "verdict": "VERIFIED",
      "evidence": "For A_ij=u_i v_j, each l-square sum is a product of independent row- and column-window sums, whose maximum occurs among the four products of their extrema. The pivot identity pA_ij=A_ic A_rj recognizes the class and supplies an exact rational factorization; evaluating all four quotients handles either sign of p. For A_ij=u_i+v_j, F_l=l(max X_l+max Y_l). Prefix sums find the required extrema in O(m+n) per length, and q(m+n)<=2mn; both classes are recognizable in O(mn).",
